summary: The claim and proof are valid. The predecessor reflection moment is used with an explicit rank, dilation, and normalization identification; the uniform-simplex bound includes zero ranks and dilations zero and one. The conditional composition factors have ranks m_1-1 and m_2-1, their product depth bound applies to actual closed halfspaces, and the block contribution has exactly four factors of the original total probability. The original total law is exactly the independent geometric product weighted by the stated bounded coordinatewise nonincreasing function. Its mean bounds, box count, fourth-power estimate, exponent conversion, and absolute constant are correct. The absolute bound is asserted and proved only in the stipulated separated-score chamber.
